name: pointer
title: Pointer
description: A custom pointer (an arrow, an emoji, any element) pops in over an area and follows a path, popping out at the end.

moworks.author: magicui

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: el is a layer over the area (position absolute, inset 0); put your own element inside it with class mw-pt-item, or leave it empty for the arrow. path: [[t, x, y], ...] px of el (linear).
moworks.titleVi: Con trỏ tuỳ chọn bật ra, đi theo
